title: Moonlighter
tagline: Dungeon by night, shopkeeper by day — dive for loot, then haggle over it.
order_note: Sections run in walkthrough order — Golem, Forest, Desert, Tech, then the final boss and a New Game+ speedrun. Playthrough 1 is the careful run: under 40 deaths, no-hit boss kills, and the broom finish on every boss. The prologue is a survive-as-long-as-you-can tutorial — grab what you can before you die. Cumulative trackers (kills, floors, notebook, decorations) carry across the whole run.
scope_note: All 57 achievements / 1,000G — the full game, no DLC. The Between Dimensions DLC has its own achievements and is out of scope. Two playthroughs: a careful first run, then a New Game+ speedrun; 25–30 hours.

achievements.name: Does It Grow on Trees?!?
achievements.how: After the prologue, hit the trees around town until one drops coins — try the main square and the lower edge of town.

achievements.name: Really?!?
achievements.how: Keep hitting town trees whenever you're back from a dungeon. The counter is glitchy and can pop early or late.

achievements.name: Distracted Merchant
achievements.how: Put 20 cheap items out at 1 gold each, one per table, and let customers wait in line until they leave without being served. Takes more than one day — sleep and repeat.

achievements.name: Evil Merchant
achievements.how: Sell 20 items at the 'expensive' price, one step above optimal — the walkthrough's price tables show the band for each item.

achievements.name: Scammer
achievements.how: Price items 'too expensive' and wait for the frowning-face valuation, 60 times. Grind it alongside Evil Merchant.

achievements.name: Naive Merchant
achievements.how: Sell 40 items at the 'cheap' price.

achievements.name: Good Merchant
achievements.req: Sell 20 items for the perfect price
achievements.how: Sell 20 items at the 'perfect' (optimal) price — use the walkthrough's price tables.

achievements.name: There Is No Avarice Without Penalty
achievements.req: Die with your inventory full of items
achievements.how: Fill every inventory slot, then die in the dungeon. Items in the top row survive, so put anything precious there first.

achievements.name: Special Place
achievements.req: Arrive at Crazy Pete's Special Place
achievements.how: In any Crazy Pete resting room, walk into the top-right corner — the wet spot by the wall. It can also pop glitched alongside Rage Against the Desert.

achievements.name: Exterminator
achievements.how: Run or roll over the tiny bugs scurrying across dungeon floors — snails and beetles in the Forest, scorpions and dung beetles in the Desert.

achievements.name: No Secrets
achievements.how: Some rooms with pitfalls sparkle for a few seconds after you enter — drop into any pitfall there. 10 secret rooms in total.

achievements.name: Horde Mode
achievements.req: Defeat three waves of enemies in a Wave Room
achievements.how: In a wave room, activate the stone-slime pillar and beat 3 waves. Don't open the chest first or the pillar implodes and the waves are gone.

achievements.name: Going for Supplies...
achievements.req: Use the Emblem in the room before the boss room
achievements.how: In the room right before a boss room, use the merchant Emblem to teleport back to town.

achievements.name: Slime Protection Service
achievements.how: In the Witch's shop, hit the slime in the pen in the left corner 42 times — only hits that make it react count, and the tracker is glitchy.

achievements.name: Saver
achievements.how: Cumulative gold collected from selling — comes naturally while working the Golem Dungeon.

achievements.name: First Investment
achievements.how: Buy the first shop-size upgrade on the Town Board — the shop's starting size counts as the first upgrade.

achievements.name: Golem Enthusiast
achievements.req: Arrive at the third floor of the Golem Dungeon 10 times
achievements.how: Reach floor 3 of the Golem Dungeon 10 times — comes with the material farming runs.

achievements.name: Rage Against the Golems
achievements.how: 1,000 Golem Dungeon kills — comes with the floor-3 repeats and material farming.

achievements.name: Overthrow the King!
achievements.how: Beat the Golem King. Three repeating phases: ground pound and shockwave, slime-fist swipe, then the falling fist — the shockwave after the rock-fall doesn't count as a hit.

achievements.name: Perfect Golem King
achievements.how: Beat him without taking a single hit. Set a portal in the room before the boss, quit to the menu from town as a checkpoint, and retry from there — it doesn't work if you die. Maxed armour and Giant Sword; time charged attacks to the falling-fist strikes for i-frames.

achievements.name: Wasteful Merchant
achievements.req: Buy more than 10 items at Le Retailer
achievements.how: Buy 11 items from Le Retailer (daytime, north-west of town). TA says more than 10; the walkthrough's 'buy ten' may already do it.

achievements.name: Expansion
achievements.how: Buy the second shop upgrade — it adds customer requests, waiting at the right side of the shop. Check the calendar page in your notebook and only take requests you can fill easily.

achievements.name: Sanitary System
achievements.how: Potions from breakable objects — urns, corpses, rocks, bushes — 20 times. Comes naturally across the dungeons.

achievements.name: Saver+
achievements.how: Cumulative 50,000 gold collected from selling.

achievements.name: Saver++
achievements.how: Cumulative 100,000 gold collected from selling.

achievements.name: Forest Enthusiast
achievements.req: Arrive at the third floor of the Forest Dungeon 10 times
achievements.how: Reach floor 3 of the Forest Dungeon 10 times.

achievements.name: Rage Against the Forest
achievements.how: 1,000 Forest Dungeon kills.

achievements.name: Prune the Plant!
achievements.how: Beat Carnivorous Mutae. Gloves up close for phase 1; bow or quick combos later. Watch for the spiral seed shots in the final phase, and ignore the respawning minions — their shots don't pass the bushes.

achievements.name: Perfect Carnivorous Mutae
achievements.how: No-hit kill — the second hardest perfect. Same portal checkpoint trick. Its minions shoot from random angles; leave them alone and focus the boss.

achievements.name: Greedy
achievements.how: Hold 1,000,000 gold on you at once — this one is not cumulative. Don't spend below it until it pops.

achievements.name: It Takes a Thief to Catch a Thief
achievements.req: Earn money from the Banker 5 times
achievements.how: Recruit the Banker (the last merchant), lend him gold, and collect a profit 5 times. Aim for +15% returns; he has a cooldown between payouts.

achievements.name: Luxury
achievements.how: Buy the third shop upgrade — it adds a shop assistant. It takes 30% of daily earnings and fails requests, so most players never use it.

achievements.name: Desert Enthusiast
achievements.req: Arrive at the third floor of the Desert Dungeon 10 times
achievements.how: Reach floor 3 of the Desert Dungeon 10 times.

achievements.name: Rage Against the Desert
achievements.how: 1,000 Desert Dungeon kills.

achievements.name: Behead the Snake!
achievements.how: Beat Naja. Destroy the body parts in order 3, 2, 1, 4 — top priority is the flame-spirit part — then the head, which only charges at that point.

achievements.name: Perfect Naja
achievements.how: No-hit kill, the hardest one — Naja's attacks are pure RNG, so watch each body part's tell and use the portal checkpoint. This is the rarest achievement in the game.

achievements.name: Heavy Warrior
achievements.how: Craft all 9 big swords, Training through Fusion and Storm. Check the merchant log — the tracker is glitchy; wait for each weapon to register before upgrading further.

achievements.name: Distant Warrior
achievements.how: Craft all 9 bows, Training through Exeter and Lightning. Same glitch warning as the other weapon trees.

achievements.name: Berserk Warrior
achievements.how: Craft all 9 gloves, Training through Star Platinum and Thunder.

achievements.name: Balanced Warrior
achievements.how: Craft all 9 short swords, Training through King and Vampire.

achievements.name: Piercing Warrior
achievements.how: Craft all 9 spears, Training through Fighter and Lightning Rod. The Broom Spear is your starting weapon and already in your log.

achievements.name: Weapon Master
achievements.how: Pops when the last of the five weapon-type achievements pops — every weapon in all five trees, found or crafted.

achievements.name: Emporium
achievements.how: Buy the final shop upgrade on the Town Board.

achievements.name: Rynoka's Major!
achievements.req: Buy all improvements on the Town Board
achievements.how: Buy every Town Board improvement — all shop upgrades, all merchants, chest, bed, cash register and discount bin. The board shows what's left.

achievements.name: Archeologist
achievements.how: Read all 12 of Crazy Pete's notes — one per floor in each dungeon, in the abandoned-campsite rooms.

achievements.name: Scribe
achievements.how: Fill the Notebook — every item in all four dungeons, including each dungeon's unique ring from purple chests.

achievements.name: Decorative Mind
achievements.how: Buy every decorative item from the Peddler — new ones unlock as you reach higher floors and beat bosses.

achievements.name: Janitor
achievements.req: Kill all bosses with the broom (last hit)
achievements.how: Land the killing blow on all four bosses with the Broom Spear. Do the perfect kill first, then reload the portal checkpoint and redo it with the broom — the other way round can glitch the tracker.

achievements.name: Savage!
achievements.how: 10,000 kills total. Grind spot: a Tech Dungeon room with a slime and a regenerator — park a shooting pet to kill the respawning slime. Five to eight hours by hand otherwise.

achievements.name: Tech Enthusiast
achievements.req: Arrive at the third floor of the Tech Dungeon 10 times
achievements.how: Reach floor 3 of the Tech Dungeon 10 times.

achievements.name: Rage Against the Machinery
achievements.how: 1,000 Tech Dungeon kills.

achievements.name: Unplug the Energy!
achievements.how: Beat Energy Flux — the easiest boss. Hide behind your shield and chip away; only the rush attack needs a dodge.

achievements.name: Perfect Energy Flux
achievements.how: No-hit kill. The shield blocks everything except the rush attack — face the boss behind the shield and strike between attacks.

achievements.name: Hero or Merchant?
achievements.how: Beat the final boss, the Space Pirate Captain — two phases, a sword alien then the big form. Tank it with hero potions and your best armour. Killing him ends the game, so finish everything else first.

achievements.name: Careful Merchant
achievements.req: Complete the game with under 40 deaths
achievements.how: Finish playthrough 1 with fewer than 40 deaths. Don't risk cheap deaths — teleport out of bad rooms instead of pushing on.

achievements.name: Gotta Go fast!
achievements.req: Beat the game in under 10 hours
achievements.how: New Game+: beat the game in under 10 hours. Gold doubles, you keep your gear, and +1 items drop — about 3 hours if you rush and skip selling. Carry red crystals and map potions from the Witch.
Pops when the last achievement does — after the New Game+ final boss.
